member.name: M:dotnet_ef_core_web_api_async.Controllers.V1.UsersController.Get
member.summary: Retrieves the details for the current authenticated user.
member.remarks: This endpoint is part of the V2 transition. It returns a greeting message along with the identity name extracted from the JWT token.
